name: NTR Chat: My Girlfriend's Travel
source:
Your girlfriend is off on a trip with her friends, and before she left, you both agreed on a free pass. Now, all you can do is text and watch as she experiences new things. As the messages roll in, will you embrace the thrill, push your limits, or struggle with the distance between you?

[From [url=https://kusobin.itch.io/my-girlfriends-travel]Itch.io[/url]]
